summary.text: N'Kiyla Thomas is the Democratic nominee. She describes herself as a Chickasaw citizen, mother, nurse and military spouse from Ardmore, Oklahoma, and not a career politician. Her campaign centers on healthcare access, education and support for families, including those raising children with disabilities.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Ardmore, Oklahoma, and graduated from Ardmore High School.
Her work experience includes nursing, work as a community health worker and time as a stay-at-home parent. Her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as nurse.

Describes herself as a Chickasaw citizen. She has been affiliated with the Chickasaw Nation, autism support and advocacy groups, military spouse networks and veterans advocacy; her husband serves in the military.
In her Ballotpedia survey she says she is raising a neurodivergent child, which she cites as a motivation for running; she has not held public office.
Advanced from the Democratic primary runoff on August 25, 2026, to become the party's nominee for U.S. Senate.
